parameters.subject: ={{ '💎 ' + ($json.isEdit ? 'Updated' : 'New') + ' Item: ' + $json.aiTitle + ' [' + $json.sku + ']' }}

parameters.responseBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  success: true,
  sku: $json.sku,
  aiTitle: $json.aiTitle,
  aiDetailedDescription: $json.aiDetailedDescription,
  aiKeyFeatures: $json.aiKeyFeatures,
  aiOccasions: $json.aiOccasions,
  aiCareInstructions: $json.aiCareInstructions,
  aiWhatsappSummary: $json.aiWhatsappSummary,
  aiStyleTip: $json.aiStyleTip,
  primaryImageUrl: $json.primaryUrl,
  allImageUrls: $json.allImageUrls,
  totalImages: $json.totalUploadedImages,
  productId: ($json.savedProduct && $json.savedProduct.id) ? $json.savedProduct.id : $json.productId,
  message: 'Product saved successfully!'
}) }}
